# AstryxSkeleton { #anylumino.AstryxSkeleton }

```python
AstryxSkeleton(width='100%', height=16, **props)
```

Render an Astryx skeleton placeholder.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default   |
|---------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| width   | int \| str | CSS width. Numbers are normalized by anylumino where supported.                                                                                                                                                     | `'100%'`  |
| height  | int \| str | CSS height. Numbers are normalized by anylumino where supported.                                                                                                                                                    | `16`      |
| **props | Any        | JSON-safe Skeleton props. Useful keys: radius, index, className, and style. The Python width and height arguments cover the size props. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Skeleton>. | `{}`      |
